column1: # Network shares HIVE mounts: THE one table of which share is which HIVE path. hive_path.sh reads
# it (a local, SMB or drive-letter path -> its HIVE path) and share_map.py reads it (a HIVE path ->
# where a collaborator browses to it on Windows or a Mac, for the session README / AGENTS.md).
# Edit here only. Tab-separated; `*` in server matches any server; `-` = not recorded.
#   Flinders: `mount` on a Core Mac, 2026-09-24: //...@128.120.208.24/proteomics on /Volumes/proteomics;
#   Quobyte:  the Core's group dir; Macs mount the proteomics-grp share at /Volumes/proteomics-grp
#             (docs/FILE_MANIFEST.md); its Windows server is not recorded here.
# access: who can open the share, for the README a collaborator reads; `-` = the paths as shown.
#   proteomics-grp is the HIVE group of Core members, so a collaborator cannot browse to it.
